clauses.heading: ## Approved-plan transition hooks
clauses.text: If the authoritative base ledger records `phase: ship` and `merged: true`, resume never re-enters pre-merge `shipping` or treats “nothing to ship” as completion.

clauses.heading: ## Tier 2 — sequential passes
clauses.text: No parallel primitive (or the caller degraded deliberately): run the same work items one at a time, each in a fresh pass with the same prompt and the same output contract.

clauses.heading: ## 14. Self-review
clauses.text: - **Discrimination check** — for every step that compares two things, run the step's own comparison on two controlled fixture pairs.
